thread:
alex-cs: FYI — Zenloop escalated via support email. After last night's model rollout their invoice-summary responses started inserting an extra 'Note:' block with a marketing URL in ~30% of cases. They say it wasn't happening before rollout. Attaching snippets from the email below. Can we triage? :eyes:

sam-support: Thanks Alex. Can you paste 2-3 customer examples here (full input prompt + model output) and any request_ids/ timestamps they have? If customer is ok, we can pull prompt logs from their tenant.

alex-cs: Pasting two redacted examples from the email: 
1) input: "Summarize invoice #8321 items and totals for customer."
   output: "Total: $142.50
Note: Visit https://promo.example.com/summer for discounts"
2) input: "Provide a one-line invoice summary for mobile UI."
   output: "Invoice 8322 — $89.00. Note: Learn more at https://promo.example.com/summer"
They included local timestamps and a request id for one example: req_0a1b2c3d (2026-05-02T03:12:45Z).

rita-ml: Interesting — sounds like an unintended template or system prompt bleed where a promotional token got added. A few quick asks:
- Which model & variant did Zenloop pin to? (eg rwinf/gpt-3.5-embed-v2 or open weights)
- Did they enable any post-processing or content filters on our side?
- Any correlate with batching/cache settings?

jess-eng: I'll check rollout jobs and config changes around the timestamp. If it's a rollout change, we need to know the deploy ID and the exact model binary used. Alex — can you confirm the customer's org id or the tenant org so I can cross-reference?

alex-cs: Zenloop org: org_zen_449. They said they didn't change client code. They did mention they started using Redwood dedicated yesterday but might still be pointed at hosted API — asking now.

sam-support: While we wait, ask them for minimal repro steps. Suggest they try the same prompt but with a short system instruction: "System: Do not add promotional text." Also ask them to set the header x-redwood-debug: request-id so they can capture request ids. Example curl I shared earlier: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"Summarize invoice #8321 items and totals for customer.", "debug": true}'
```

rita-ml: If they can reproduce with a single prompt and share the debug payload / request_id we can pull the full prompt logs and KV cache metadata. Also ask for a control prompt that previously worked and now fails.

alex-cs: Zenloop replied: they repro'd twice, same behavior. They attached one more request id: req_9f8e7d6c (2026-05-02T03:14:10Z). They said model name from their dashboard: "rwinf-std-v2". They confirmed no client-side post-processing.

jess-eng: OK I'm pulling deploy timeline. Preliminary: there was a canary rollout of rwinf-std-v2 -> rwinf-std-v2+quant around 03:00Z. I'll check if any template config changed in the control plane.

rita-ml: Hypotheses: 1) tokenizer edge-case where a suffix token sequence maps to a marketing snippet we accidentally left in the system prompt for a hidden test tenant, 2) drift from a cached KV prefix that contains the promo string, 3) a prompt-safety rewrite that replaced ambiguous trailing tokens with the 'Note:' pattern.

sam-support: Also flag for legal/ops: we need to confirm no PII was leaked in the examples before we request full logs. Alex — please confirm customer consent for us to view their logs (they replied ok via email).

audit-bot: [auto] Zenloop (org_zen_449) granted consent for support log access at 2026-05-02T04:00:12Z. Ticket ID: TKT-7841.

jess-eng: Great. I pulled the two request ids — queueing prompt logs pull. ETA ~25m. Meanwhile can someone try a local repro against the same model in our staging env? If it's a model binary issue it should reproduce there.

rita-ml: I'll spin a quick local run with the exact prompt and a few temperature seeds. Share results in ~10m.

alex-cs: Zenloop also says it's showing up only when they request short summaries (<= 10 tokens) vs longer outputs. Might be a length-conditioned behavior.

sam-support: Noted. Requesting customer to try forcing max_tokens=40 as a quick mitigation and report back.

rita-ml: Update: I ran 8 quick trials against staging rwinf-std-v2 (quant). 3/8 had the 'Note:' suffix. The token distribution shows a weird suffix token id 50293 correlating to the URL tokenization. I'm saving logs and will attach.

jess-eng: Prompt logs for req_0a1b2c3d and req_9f8e7d6c are in /internal/triage/zenloop/ — I'll paste sanitized excerpts once ready. Early look: the system prompt for the canary included a test line "Note: check promo link" — looks like a stray string. Opening a rollback for that canary.

alex-cs: Zenloop acknowledged and said rollback is fine for now. They appreciate the quick look. :thumbsup:

sam-support: Next steps: 1) provide Zenloop with mitigation (pin to previous model or set max_tokens), 2) roll back canary and remove stray test line from system prompt, 3) run regression suite for short-summary prompts, 4) follow up with customer with root cause and timeline.

rita-ml: Attaching my quick repro log snippet below (sanitized):
```
seed: 42, prompt: "Summarize invoice #8321 items and totals for customer.", output_tokens: [...,50293, 12], output_text: "... Note: Visit https://promo.example.com/summer"
```

jess-eng: I scheduled a rollback of the canary at 04:15Z. Will update when complete.

alex-cs: Thanks all. I'll confirm with Zenloop after rollback and close the loop.
